newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman shares end higher, service shares dominate.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares end higher, service shares dominate.

text.p: Shares on Oman's stock exchange ended the week to Wednesday higher with interest focused on service sector shares, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The MSM index closed higher at 183.93 points from 182.22.
Of the 54 companies traded in the week, shares of 22 rose, 10 fell, and 22 were unchanged, the MSM said.
Oman International Bank closed at 2.600 rials from 2.520 rials last week, Oman Aviation Services ended at 2.920 rials from a previous 2.860 rials.
Service sector shares accounted for 44 percent of total trading value of 2.57 million rials ($6.8 million) from 2.54 million rials the previous week.
